title: Use the configured CTest environment for WSL captures
body: Failed comparison: the queued baseline capture comparator exited 1 after the direct tools/run-vixen-windowed-captures.sh run produced four editor PNGs with center-only pixel differences against the official CTest witness (all three HUD PNGs matched). The CTest witness injects DISPLAY=:0 and VIXEN_CTEST_GPU_ENVIRONMENT; two consecutive official runs were byte-identical. Make the standalone capture helper obtain that configured Vulkan loader environment, or make the common lane recipe use the official CTest witness.

title: Use non-destructive unique paths for queued witness status files
body: A foreground interval watcher command containing rm -f for its per-run log/status path was blocked by the worktree-guard hook before execution. I switched to unique log and status names without cleanup. The watcher guidance should provide a non-destructive unique-path pattern, or the guard should distinguish a task-local generated log from destructive worktree cleanup.

title: Generate identity-equivalent affine SDF shader specialization
body: To preserve byte-identical identity-scale procedural pixels after adopting the affine transform stream, TraceWorld.glsl uses preserveLegacyProcedural guards to retain the old world-space ray operation order in primary and shadow paths. The declarative transform form does not encode or generate this compatibility specialization. Consolidate by deriving an identity-equivalent affine shader path from the transform contract.
